title: Canada suspends trade negotiations with USA and match tariffs dollar for dollar
titleZh: 加拿大暂停与美国的贸易谈判，并对美元征收关税
author: backlit4034
relevanceReason: 命中 1 个 AI/科技关键词。
summaryRaw: “Over the past 18 months, Canada’s new government has focused on building our strength at home, diversifying our partnerships abroad, and striking a fair deal with the United States.Our objectives in our trade negotiations have been to:Preserve tariff-free access to the U.S. for the vast majority of Canadian business;Provide greater stability to our trade relationship;Significantly reduce U.S. tariffs on our key strategic industries, so that Canadian businesses in these sectors would have the best access of any in the world;Protect our small and medium-sized businesses – the lifeblood of our economy – including by removing the imminent threat of new tariffs; andMaintain our flexibility, independence, and sovereignty so we can keep building the Canada we want.We have recognised from the beginning that America has changed, and that we will not return to our old relationship. Our government understood, before many, that America is altering all its trade relationships. Putting tariffs on its closest allies and charging for access to its vast market.We have worked in that context. To strike a fair deal that would provide the best access to the U.S. market and greater certainty to Canadian businesses and workers. Throughout, our goal has been to secure the best deal for Canadians, never a deal at any price or on any deadline.In recent weeks, we made important progress toward improving Canada’s position as having the best deal in the world with the U.S.However, that progress has not been enough to meet our objectives for Canadians. As a result, this evening, I have decided to suspend trade negotiations with the U.S. and have directed Canada’s negotiators to return to Ottawa. They have worked hard, in good faith, to defend the interests of Canadians throughout these negotiations up until the very last minute. However, last-minute changes in the U.S. proposed terms were unfair, uneconomic, and called into question the reliability of any deal.At midnight tonight, the U.S. intends to impose a 50% tariff on roughly $28 billion of Canadian goods. Canada will match those tariffs dollar for dollar to protect our workers and businesses.In the coming days, the government will introduce additional measures to support Canadian workers and businesses, building on the nearly $25 billion in support provided over the past 18 months.These actions complement Canada’s core economic strategy. From day one, we have been focused on building our strength at home and diversifying our partnerships abroad.That strategy is working. We are advancing nearly $500 billion in major infrastructure projects. In parallel, we are unlocking new export markets for Canadian businesses. Our existing free trade deals already provide Canada with preferential access to 1.5 billion consumers, and we are on track to double that market access by the end of this year.Canadian economic growth is accelerating, and we are on course to have the second-fastest growth in the G7 over the next two years. Our economy is creating jobs at four times the rate of the United States. Our exports to non-U.S. markets are on track to double over the next decade. Foreign direct investment in Canada is at its highest level in two decades, running at twice the rate of our nearest G7 competitor. Canada now ranks as the most attractive country in the world for infrastructure investment.Canada has what the world wants. And we will not allow any nation to determine our future. We will set our own course to keep building Canada strong for all.”

comments.author: hunglee2
comments.textRawHtml:
The world should've collectively recognised what Liberation Day was and responded together, in lock step, and in kind.

Instead, the Europeans caved, Japanese caved (PM resigned after doing so), Republic of Korea caved (PM resigned after doing so), India of course caved and so on, shattering any prospect of collective action which might pull the rogue hegemon back into line.

Now, the US is simply able to renege or renegotiate the bilateral deals whenever he feels like it, forcing the other party to face down the US by themselves - not many can do this, maybe only China. Anyways, I wish the Canadians well and I hope they gain global support
comments.textZhHtml:
世界应该集体认识到什么是解放日，并共同做出反应，步调一致，以同样的方式做出反应。

相反，欧洲屈服了，日本屈服了（首相辞职后辞职），韩国屈服了（总理辞职后当然辞职了），印度屈服了等等，粉碎了任何可能将流氓霸权拉回正轨的集体行动的前景。

现在，美国只要他愿意，他就能随时食言或重新谈判双边协议，迫使对方自己面对美国——没有多少人能做到这一点，也许只有中国。不管怎样，我祝愿加拿大人一切顺利，并希望他们获得全球的支持

children.author: Chyzwar
children.textRawHtml: That not how politics works. It is much slower and hidden process. EU fast tracked Mercosur and other trade deals. China and Japan is slowly dumping US treasury bills, Canada is in open trade confrontation and is diversifying toward China. Everybody is shifting away from US weapons suppliers. Nobody is willing to help with Iran even on symbolic level.
children.textZhHtml: 政治不是这样运作的。这是一个缓慢且隐藏的过程。欧盟快速跟踪南方共同市场和其他贸易协定。中国和日本正在慢慢抛售美国国债，加拿大正处于公开贸易对抗中，并且正在对中国实行多元化。每个人都在远离美国武器供应商。没有人愿意帮助伊朗，即使是象征性的。

children.author: LeFantome
children.textRawHtml:
You are both right. The world capitulates more than it should. But the world is also moving away and building contingencies.

The world needs leadership. And Canada is helping with that.

I do not think that reciprocal tariffs are actually the answer though. They hurt both sides and the US is not a rational enough actor to respond like you hope they will. The answer is in shifting trade away from the US and isolating their economy. It takes longer but it is what will work. And even if their behaviour does not change, their power will fade with their economy.
children.textZhHtml:
你们都是对的。世界的屈服超出了应有的程度。但世界也在逐渐远离并引发突发事件。

世界需要领导力。加拿大正在为此提供帮助。

但我认为互惠关税实际上并不是答案。他们伤害了双方，而美国不是一个足够理性的行为体，无法像你希望的那样做出回应。答案是将贸易从美国转移并孤立其经济。这需要更长的时间，但这是有效的。即使他们的行为不改变，他们的权力也会随着经济的发展而减弱。

children.author: benjiro29
children.textRawHtml:
*Nobody is willing to help with Iran even on symbolic level*

Most people do not realize how much of a shift that is.

In the past there was always a ton of EU countries helping the US out, in whatever crap the US started. And a lot of European soldiers died. Those soldiers did not help Europe but the US, because of being allies.

Even when some European countries got called names for not helping in Iraq because they called out that the whole Weapons Of Mass destruction was a load of bull** . It did not stop others from helping the US.

Yet, now, what we see as "help" is so minimal, and even countries like Spain not just refusing but active blocking. It shows how much relationships have deteriorated.

Trump thinks of Europa like a vassal state, and every time we say no or delay, it drives him nuts. Or our best "yes", if often a "well, we need to have agreement in all the countries, see you in a few years". Do not think its coincidence, its done deliberately.

In the past when the US said something, beyond maybe France, most countries quickly followed. This is gone ... We know the world has changed, and the old order is finished.
children.textZhHtml:
*即使是象征性的，也没有人愿意帮助伊朗*

大多数人没有意识到这是一个多大的转变。

过去总是有大量的欧盟国家帮助美国摆脱困境，无论美国发起了什么垃圾。许多欧洲士兵死亡。这些士兵没有帮助欧洲，而是帮助了美国，因为他们是盟友。

即使一些欧洲国家因为没有在伊拉克提供帮助而受到诟病，因为他们声称整个大规模杀伤性武器都是一派胡言**。这并没有阻止其他国家向美国提供帮助。

然而，现在我们所看到的“帮助”却微乎其微，就连西班牙这样的国家不仅不拒绝，还积极阻止。这显示了关系恶化的程度。

特朗普认为欧罗巴就像一个附庸国，每次我们说不或拖延，都会让他发疯。或者我们最好的“是”，如果经常是“好吧，我们需要在所有国家达成协议，几年后见”。别以为这是巧合，这是故意的。

以前美国一说了什么，也许除了法国之外，大多数国家都会迅速跟风。这已经消失了......我们知道世界已经改变，旧秩序已经结束。

children.author: wwice
children.textRawHtml:
>> India of course caved and so on,

India and US still have not signed any trade deal. Not sure what's the basis of your comment.
children.textZhHtml:
>> 印度当然屈服了等等，

印度和美国仍然没有签署任何贸易协议。不确定您的评论的基础是什么。

children.author: nojvek
children.textRawHtml:
India and China have their own trade books.

No one other than close US allies caved.

And even then, they all realize Trump is a mad man and cannot be relied upon.
children.textZhHtml:
印度和中国有自己的贸易手册。

除了美国的亲密盟友之外，没有人屈服。

即便如此，他们都意识到特朗普是个疯子，不能依赖。

children.author: nubg
children.textRawHtml: > Sir he is a Pakistani not Indian!
children.textZhHtml: >先生，他是巴基斯坦人而不是印度人！

children.author: bambax
children.textRawHtml:
Absolutely agree; but it's never too late to react. Europe could impose tariffs on US tech or forbid it altogether to bid on government contracts. Etc.

What are we waiting for.
children.textZhHtml:
完全同意；但反应永远不会太晚。欧洲可以对美国技术征收关税或完全禁止其竞标政府合同。等等

我们还在等什么。

children.author: hunglee2
children.textRawHtml: the bilateral deals signed means we (the world, minus the US) is already divided. Got to scrap those deals first, which isn't going to happen. The shark has scattered the shoal and we're all going to get picked off - perpetually signing worse deals, then having to renegotiate again before signing ever worse terms.
children.textZhHtml: 双边协议的签署意味着我们（世界，不包括美国）已经分裂。必须先取消这些交易，但这不会发生。鲨鱼已经分散了浅滩，我们都会被盯上——永远签署更糟糕的协议，然后在签署更糟糕的条款之前必须再次重新谈判。

children.author: LeFantome
children.textRawHtml: Why does any country need a deal with the US? Canada is more integrated than anybody and they are walking away. Canada believes productive trade with the rest of the world is better than a bad deal with the US. China was prepared to do the same. The world should take notice.
children.textZhHtml: 为什么任何国家都需要与美国达成协议？加拿大比任何国家都更加一体化，但他们正在离开。加拿大认为，与世界其他国家进行富有成效的贸易比与美国达成糟糕的协议要好。中国也准备这样做。世界应该注意到。

children.author: amelius
children.textRawHtml: If Trump can scrap bilateral deals, then others can too, using similar tactics if necessary.
children.textZhHtml: 如果特朗普可以废除双边协议，那么其他人也可以，并在必要时使用类似的策略。

children.author: morkalork
children.textRawHtml: Apparently all you have to do is impose a digital services tax and he'll rip it up for you.
children.textZhHtml: 显然，您所要做的就是征收数字服务税，他就会为您撕毁。

children.author: amelius
children.textRawHtml: That tax would make a lot of sense, actually.
children.textZhHtml: 事实上，这项税收很有意义。

children.author: enraged_camel
children.textRawHtml:
>> What are we waiting for.

For Europe to become fully self-sufficient when it comes to defense, for one thing.
children.textZhHtml:
>> 我们还在等什么。

一方面，欧洲在国防方面要完全自给自足。

children.author: LeFantome
children.textRawHtml:
I think it can be Europe, Canada, Australia, and South Korea.

The world has the technology. Canada has the resources and the manufacturing capacity. Europe has the money. It can be done.

Look at Ukraine. They are becoming a military superpower in terms of technology and experience.
children.textZhHtml:
我认为可以是欧洲、加拿大、澳大利亚和韩国。

世界拥有这项技术。加拿大有资源和制造能力。欧洲有钱。这是可以做到的。

看看乌克兰。他们正在成为技术和经验方面的军事超级大国。

children.author: disgruntledphd2
children.textRawHtml:
Honestly, if Trump keeps giving intelligence to Ukraine against Russia, then it was worth paying the (idiotic) tariffs.

That was the EUs top priority. The other issue was that each country had its own products they didn't want to lose sales from.

More generally, the EU isn't built for a world of presidential powers exercised at whom, which is becoming more of an issue this decade.
children.textZhHtml:
老实说，如果特朗普继续向乌克兰提供针对俄罗斯的情报，那么支付（愚蠢的）关税是值得的。

这是欧盟的首要任务。另一个问题是，每个国家都有自己的产品，他们不想失去销售。

更一般地说，欧盟并不是为了一个总统权力由谁行使的世界而建立的，这在这十年变得越来越成为一个问题。

children.author: k33n
children.textRawHtml:
> What are we waiting for.

Responsible governance around something like when and how to retaliate (if at all) against tariffs comes down to one of the most fundamental forces of economics and trade: real leverage. Whether or not the US should exercise its leverage to attain outsized and favorable terms on the economic stage is the peanut gallery conversation that happens on social media. The two worlds couldn't be farther apart. What will actually happen in the end is just a math equation that has never changed and will never change.
children.textZhHtml:
> 我们还在等什么。

围绕何时以及如何报复（如果有的话）关税等问题进行负责任的治理，归结为经济和贸易最基本的力量之一：实际杠杆。美国是否应该利用其影响力在经济舞台上获得超额优惠条件，这是社交媒体上的热门话题。两个世界已经不能再遥远了。最终实际发生的只是一个从未改变、也永远不会改变的数学方程式。

children.author: dzonga
children.textRawHtml:
they carved because most of those places want access to the 'yuuuge' US market.

politics vs reality. they could correct though by selling US treasuries - but that would make the world economy sneeze which might result in pneumonia.
children.textZhHtml:
他们之所以这么做，是因为大多数地方都希望进入“yuuuge”美国市场。

政治与现实。他们可以通过出售美国国债来纠正——但这会让世界经济打喷嚏，从而可能导致肺炎。

children.author: fifilura
children.textRawHtml:
The parent point is that the response should have been done collectively.

USA market is "yuuge", but rest-of-the-world market is much much bigger.
children.textZhHtml:
母点是应对措施应该集体完成。

美国市场是“yuuge”，但世界其他市场要大得多。
